zh-CN.title: 《道德经》注本写本记录（对象占位）

zh-CN.researchNote: 需补馆藏机构、编号、材质、年代、注家归属、流传与图像权利。

en.title: Daodejing commentary manuscript record (object placeholder)

en.researchNote: Collection, accession, material, date, attribution, provenance and image rights are required.

zh-CN.title: 道教宫观碑刻拓片记录（对象占位）

curatorialDescription: 当前只定义对象需求，不声称某一拓片已经入藏或获授权。
zh-CN.researchNote: 需落实原碑、拓片馆藏、释文、年代、地点、编号及使用许可。

en.title: Daoist institutional inscription rubbing (object placeholder)

curatorialDescription: The record defines an object need; it does not claim that a rubbing is held or licensed.
en.researchNote: Original stele, rubbing collection, transcription, date, place, accession and licence are required.

zh-CN.title: 官学经典卷子记录（对象占位）

en.title: State-school classics scroll (object placeholder)

curatorialDescription: The object type remains separate from any particular manuscript of the Corrected Meanings; no collection is assigned.
en.researchNote: Classic, date, material, text version, accession and image licence are required.
